channels.name: Open25-DM32 Classic
channels.description: RadioFoundry UI · FM, DMR, conventional P25 and NXDN

releases.notes: Classic r14 refreshes the radio to current RadioFoundry upstream while retaining our band policy and necessary fixes. A distinct Open25 boot emblem and persistent Classic home banner identify this edition. FM, DMR, conventional P25 and NXDN are supported. Extended receive is always enabled; transmit remains within 136–174 and 400–480 MHz with narrower P25 limits. Updating the exact public r13 build checks and converts supported P25 programming to native contact links without dropping settings. Conversion requires saving a verified recovery ZIP before any writes. Unsupported records, insufficient capacity and unknown source firmware are refused before flashing. Use the matched Classic CPS for r14; older r13 backups are not interchangeable with native r14 programming. Bounded four-mode hardware and migration/recovery checks passed; long-term endurance and physical microphone loudness parity are not established.
